verdict.rationale: Lists can be managed programmatically through the Value Lists API, which covers updating a blocklist. Read-side signals are available via the Early Fraud Warnings and Reviews APIs. An official Stripe MCP server and CLI exist that an agent could use. However, custom rules are documented only as created in the Dashboard, and fraud analytics is likewise Dashboard-based. The only approval primitive shown is approving payment reviews, not human sign-off on agent-proposed rule or list changes. Missing for 10: a programmatic rules API for proposing or creating velocity rules, API access to fraud-insights posture, Radar-specific MCP tools, approval gates for agent-initiated configuration changes, and hands-on corroboration.
